info.label: Creation Records
info.desc: loveless is the second studio album by Irish shoegaze band my bloody valentine, released on 4 November 1991 by Creation Records. The album was recorded over a two-year period between 1989 and 1991. Vocalist and guitarist Kevin Shields dominated the arduous recording process; intent on achieving a particular sound, he experimented with guitar tremolo techniques and tuning systems, unorthodox production methods, obscured vocals, and sampled percussion and feedback. The group cycled through nineteen studios and a larger number of engineers during the album's two-year creation, with total recording costs rumoured to have reached £250,000. Its production was so expensive that it nearly bankrupted their original label. "After releasing the Lovelace album in 1991, that groundbreaking noise pop album that was the epitome of the shoegazer sound and everything that descended from it, not a lot happened."

podcast.body: Released in 1991, *Loveless* is considered the band's "biggest contribution" to music. It was recorded over two years in 19 different studios, a process so extensive and costly that it "nearly bankrupted their record label." Despite not selling in "appreciable numbers," its influence significantly "far outweighed its commercial performance," deeply impacting artists like Trent Reznor, Billy Corgan, Robert Smith, Courtney Love, and The Edge of U2. "It was an album called Loveless that was recorded over two years in 19 different studios. And it was so expensive that it nearly bankrupted their record label."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The band's second album, released in 1991, is widely regarded as the absolute classic of Shoegaze, a record that redefined guitar-based music, and one of the most influential works of the 1990s. Its production was an odyssey of chaos, extending over two and a half years and passing through 19 recording studios, bringing Creation Records to the brink of bankruptcy. Despite selling well, it initially fell far short of recouping its investment, partly due to its release only a month and a half after Nirvana's market-breaking album "Nevermind." Today, it is an undeniable and timeless classic. "Lofless nace del caos, la confusión y el agotamiento, según lo que se podría haber hecho de una forma mucho más fácil y con menos cabezonería, si Charles se hubiese dejado ayudar, pero este proceso no es un disco único y repetible."

podcast.body: This album took two years to make and literally bankrupted the Creation label due to its intensive production. Despite the financial cost, "Loveless" is still widely cited as a sonic blueprint that influenced hundreds, if not thousands, of bands throughout the 1990s and up to the present day. "My Bloody Valentine spent two years making an album called Lovelace, that literally bankrupted Creation."
